aggregate.text: If {households} households each replace one {roundTripKm} km car round trip a day, that is about {carKm} fewer car-km a week. This assumes {roundTripKm} km for the whole round trip and {daysPerWeek} days a week, which are Saans assumptions and not measured figures.

source.title: Saans rule: a household replaces one 6 km car round trip a day, 5 days a week

guardSource.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure I item 1
guardSource.quote: Avoid outdoor morning and late evening walk, run, jog and physical exercise

action.title: Hold outdoor time from {start} to {end}
action.body: Of your outdoor slots, the cleaner time is {start} to {end}, at about {pm25} micrograms per cubic metre of fine particles. Hold assembly, sport or play then if you can.

poor.title: Least bad outdoor time: {start} to {end}
poor.body: The air is poor all day. If an activity cannot move indoors or to another day, {start} to {end} is the least bad time among your slots, at about {pm25} micrograms per cubic metre of fine particles. Keep it short and light.

action.reason: Saans compares the forecast for each of your outdoor slots and the hours around it, and picks the lowest. It follows the same limits as the family plan: on poor days nothing before 10:00 or after 19:00.

source.title: Saans rule: pick the outdoor slot and time with the lowest forecast fine particles

then.title: Limit outdoor activity and postpone running and sports
then.body: On days like this, keep break times indoors and avoid or postpone running, jogging and games outdoors. Move the physical education period inside or to a later day.
then.reason: The health ministry advises schools to limit outdoor activity on poor-air days and to avoid or postpone running, jogging and playing.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure IV section 5 item iv
source.quote: Physical activities like running, jogging, playing may be avoided or postponed

then.title: Keep classroom windows shut
then.body: Close classroom windows while the air is poor. Open them again when the air improves, and use exhaust fans where there are any.
then.reason: The health ministry advises schools to close windows when the air quality is poor and above.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure IV section 4 item iv
source.quote: To close windows if air quality level is poor and above

then.title: Wet mop the floors before students arrive
then.body: Mop floors with a damp cloth before children come in, rather than sweeping while they are in the building.
then.reason: The health ministry advises wet mopping for floor cleaning in schools or before students arrive.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure IV section 4 item v
source.quote: To adopt wet mopping for floor cleaning in school or before students arrive to school

then.title: Show today's AQI where students and teachers can see it
then.body: Put the day's AQI on a notice board or at the gate, so students and teachers know why outdoor time is limited.
then.reason: The health ministry advises schools to display the AQI to students and teachers when it is poor and above.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure IV section 5 item i
source.quote: To display, if possible, to students/ teachers of AQI levels and alert

then.title: Reschedule sports competitions in November and December
then.body: If a sports day or match is planned in November or December, check the air forecast and be ready to move it to a cleaner day.
then.reason: CAQM Advisory No. 18 asks for sports competitions in the NCR during November and December to be rescheduled when the air quality trends call for it.

source.title: Press Information Bureau, Commission for Air Quality Management, 30th meeting, Advisory No. 18
source.quote: physical sports competitions scheduled in NCR during November-December should be appropriately rescheduled, keeping in view the air quality trends prevailing in the area, particularly in the interest of protecting the health of students

then.title: Keep classrooms ventilated while the air is clean
then.body: Open classroom windows properly, or use exhaust fans, while the air outside is not poor. Close them if the air turns poor.
then.reason: The health ministry advises proper classroom ventilation, and closing windows when the air quality is poor and above.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure IV section 4 item iii
source.quote: Ensure proper classroom ventilation by opening windows properly or installing exhaust fans

then.title: Use marker pens instead of chalk
then.body: Switching from chalk to marker pens on the board keeps chalk dust out of the classroom air.
then.reason: The health ministry suggests marker pens for writing on the board instead of chalk.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure IV section 4 item vi
source.quote: Marker pens may be used for writing on board instead of chalks.

then.title: Encourage school buses and car-pooling for the school run
then.body: Ask families to use school buses, public transport or shared rides, so fewer cars queue at the gate.
then.reason: The health ministry advises schools to encourage public transport and car-pooling.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure IV section 3

then.title: Give guards and staff electric heaters
then.body: Resident welfare associations can provide electric heaters to security, sanitation and garden staff, so nobody burns waste or wood to keep warm in winter.
then.reason: GRAP Stage II asks resident welfare associations in Delhi NCR to provide electric heaters to staff to avoid open burning in winter.

source.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage II actions
source.quote: Resident Welfare Associations to necessarily provide electric heaters to staff engaged in security, sanitation, horticulture and other miscellaneous services to avoid open Bio-Mass/ MSW burning during winters.

then.title: Let people work from home where their job allows
then.body: On the worst days, allow work from home for roles that can do it, and keep meetings that need travel to a minimum.
then.reason: The GRAP citizens charter, written for Delhi NCR, says people whose positions allow it may work from home.

source.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage III citizens charter
source.quote: People, whose positions allow working from home, may work from home.

then.title: Run the air conditioning on recirculate
then.body: On poor-air days set office air conditioning to recirculate, so it does not pull in outside air.
then.reason: The health ministry advises recirculate mode for air conditioners in buildings and vehicles.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure I section III item 3
source.quote: When operating air conditioners in buildings or vehicle, use in "re-circulate" mode to avoid contact with outside air.

then.title: Move outdoor events to a cleaner day or hour, or indoors
then.body: Reschedule outdoor activities for the day when the air is cleaner, and keep them indoors on poor and worse days.
then.reason: The health ministry advises rescheduling outdoor activities as per the AQI and staying indoors on poor to severe days.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure I item 9
source.quote: Reschedule outdoor activities as per AQI, and remain indoors on days with poor to severe AQI.

then.title: Report open burning and polluting vehicles through the city apps
then.body: If you see waste or leaves burning, or a vehicle with visible smoke, report it through the 311 App, the Green Delhi App or the SAMEER App.
then.reason: The GRAP citizens charter asks people in Delhi to report air-polluting activities through these apps.

source.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage I citizens charter
source.quote: Report air polluting activities through 311 App, Green Delhi App, SAMEER App etc.

then.title: Do not burn waste, leaves or wood in the open
then.body: Do not burn waste, leaves, crop residue or wood in the open, and ask maintenance and security staff not to light fires for warmth or to clear rubbish.
then.reason: The health ministry advises against burning wood, leaves, crop residues and waste in the open.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure I item 6
source.quote: Avoid burning in open any form of wood, leaves, crop residues, & waste.

then.title: Encourage public transport and shared rides
then.body: Share timetables and set up a ride-sharing group, so fewer people drive alone.
then.reason: The health ministry advises using public transport whenever possible.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure II item 20
source.quote: Use public transport whenever possible to reduce air pollution.

then.title: Ask drivers to switch the engine off while they wait
then.body: Put up a sign at the gate or car park asking drivers to turn off the engine while they wait.
then.reason: The GRAP citizens charter, written for Delhi NCR, asks drivers not to idle and to turn off the engine at red lights.

source.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage I citizens charter
source.quote: Do not idle your vehicle, also turn off the engine at red lights.

then.title: Check the day's AQI before planning outdoor events
then.body: Look at the air forecast before you plan a function, a game or a morning assembly, and choose the cleaner hours.
then.reason: The health ministry advises checking the AQI before planning outdoor activities.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure II item 34
source.quote: Do check the AQI before planning your outdoor activities for the day.

then.title: Tell people what to do if they feel unwell
then.body: Put up a notice asking anyone with breathlessness, giddiness, cough, chest discomfort or pain, or red or watery eyes to see a doctor.
then.reason: The health ministry advises consulting a doctor for these symptoms.

source.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health, Annexure I item 12
source.quote: Consult the nearest doctor in case of breathlessness, giddiness, cough, chest discomfort or pain
